title: Set up
intro: What the event needs, in the order it's usually done. Each step says what's there and opens the one place it is set.
introAccount: Welcome. First, the account you will sign in with: it becomes the admin.
alreadyDone: Floorbit is set up. Only an admin sees the checklist.
adminOnly: An admin is still setting up Floorbit.

account.text: Floorbit printed a setup code to its log when it started. It proves you run this server.
account.codeHelp: Find it with: docker compose logs floorbit

finish.later: You can come back to this checklist from Settings at any time.
finish.open: Done for now, open the floor plan

check.title: Event setup

event.title: Event: name, dates and logo
event.done: Name, dates and logo are set.
event.doneNoLogo: Name and dates are set. A logo is optional.

inventory.title: Inventory: switches and devices
inventory.netboxEmpty: NetBox is connected, but no devices came in yet. Sync it on the Inventory page.
inventory.none: Connect NetBox, or add the switches by hand on the Inventory page.

monitoring.title: Monitoring: a local agent and live status
monitoring.done_one: {{connected}} of {{count}} agent connected, live status is on.
monitoring.done_other: {{connected}} of {{count}} agents connected, live status is on.
monitoring.noAgent: Enrol a local agent: it is how Floorbit reaches the event network.
monitoring.offline: No agent is connected right now.
monitoring.noSource: Turn on LibreNMS or telemetry for live switch status.

floor.title: Floor plan: seat blocks and switches
floor.noSwitches: Place the switches where they stand.

seats.title: Seats to ports
seats.checkinOnly: Check-in is on, but no seat has its port yet.
seats.none: Map seats to switch ports, walk the hall with the seat walk-through, or turn on check-in.

alerts.title: Alerts: Discord or webhooks
alerts.none: Connect Discord or add a webhook, so the crew hears about trouble.

crew.title: Crew accounts and teams
crew.alone: Only one account so far. Add the crew and their teams.

check.nudge: Event setup: {{done}} of {{count}} steps done. Next: {{next}}.
